title: SolarWinds Orion supply-chain compromise
summary: CISA ordered federal agencies to disconnect affected SolarWinds Orion products after a supply-chain compromise was identified.
summary_zh: SolarWinds Orion软件供应链被入侵，CISA要求联邦机构断开受影响版本。
root_cause: Software build and update supply chain compromise
impact: Downstream organizations installed compromised software updates.

title: Microsoft Exchange Server exploitation
title_zh: Microsoft Exchange Server漏洞利用事件
summary: CISA issued an emergency directive in response to active exploitation of on-premises Microsoft Exchange Server vulnerabilities.
summary_zh: 攻击者利用本地部署Exchange Server漏洞，CISA发布紧急指令要求排查与修复。
root_cause: Active exploitation of internet-facing Exchange Server vulnerabilities
impact: Unauthorized access and follow-on compromise of affected servers.

title: Colonial Pipeline ransomware incident
summary: A ransomware incident disrupted Colonial Pipeline operations and led to a federal response and investigation.
summary_zh: 勒索软件事件导致Colonial Pipeline暂停部分运营并引发美国联邦调查和响应。
root_cause: Compromised remote-access credentials were reported in subsequent public testimony
impact: Operational disruption and regional fuel supply concerns.

title: Log4Shell exploitation risk
summary: CISA coordinated government-wide action for the widely exploited Apache Log4j vulnerability.
summary_zh: Apache Log4j远程代码执行漏洞被广泛利用，CISA协调政府部门开展紧急处置。
root_cause: Vulnerable Log4j versions embedded across software supply chains
impact: Remote code execution exposure across a large and difficult-to-inventory attack surface.

title: Kaseya VSA ransomware supply-chain incident
summary: CISA and the FBI published guidance after ransomware actors exploited Kaseya VSA and affected managed service providers and customers.
summary_zh: 勒索攻击者利用Kaseya VSA影响托管服务商及其客户，形成供应链扩散。
impact: Downstream encryption and service disruption across managed customers.

sources.name: CISA-FBI guidance for Kaseya ransomware attack

title: 3CX DesktopApp supply-chain compromise
summary: A compromised 3CX DesktopApp update delivered malicious code to downstream users.
summary_zh: 被篡改的3CX DesktopApp更新向下游用户传播恶意代码。
impact: Trojanized software was distributed through a trusted update channel.

title: MOVEit Transfer mass exploitation
summary: Cl0p actors exploited a MOVEit Transfer zero-day and stole data from many organizations.
summary_zh: Cl0p攻击者利用MOVEit Transfer零日漏洞从多家机构窃取数据。
root_cause: SQL injection vulnerability in internet-facing file transfer software
impact: Large-scale data theft and downstream extortion.

title: Okta customer support system incident
title_zh: Okta客户支持系统安全事件
summary: Okta reported unauthorized access to files in its customer support system and described the scope and remediation.
summary_zh: Okta披露客户支持系统文件遭未授权访问，并公布调查范围与整改。
root_cause: Compromise of a service account used to access the customer support system
impact: Customer-uploaded support files were accessed and some sessions were targeted.

sources.name: Okta customer support system incident update

title: OpenAI chat history exposure incident
summary: OpenAI described a Redis client library bug that exposed some users' chat history titles and limited billing-related information.
summary_zh: OpenAI披露Redis客户端库缺陷导致部分用户聊天标题及有限账单信息暴露。
root_cause: Bug in an open-source Redis client library under specific cancellation behavior
impact: Cross-user information exposure for a limited set of users.

title: XZ Utils supply-chain compromise
summary: Malicious code was discovered in XZ Utils release tarballs, leading to urgent distribution and government guidance.
summary_zh: XZ Utils发布包被植入恶意代码，引发Linux发行版及安全机构紧急处置。
organization: XZ Utils project and downstream distributions
root_cause: Malicious code introduced into upstream release artifacts
impact: Potential authentication bypass/backdoor exposure in affected distributions.

title: Change Healthcare ransomware disruption
title_zh: Change Healthcare勒索软件与业务中断
summary: A cyberattack disrupted Change Healthcare services used across the U.S. health system and prompted federal response activity.
summary_zh: 网络攻击导致Change Healthcare多项服务中断，并对美国医疗支付与处方流程造成广泛影响。
root_cause: Unauthorized access followed by ransomware deployment
impact: Extended operational disruption across healthcare payment and pharmacy workflows.

sources.name: HHS Change Healthcare cybersecurity response
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services

title: CrowdStrike Windows sensor outage
title_zh: CrowdStrike Windows传感器大范围中断
summary: A faulty CrowdStrike content configuration update caused Windows systems to crash, producing global operational disruption; it was not a cyberattack.
summary_zh: CrowdStrike内容配置更新缺陷导致Windows系统崩溃并产生全球性业务中断；该事件并非网络攻击。
root_cause: Defect in a content configuration update
impact: Large-scale system crashes and operational disruption across multiple industries.
